text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, Special Week called out to me
looking somewhat panicked.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Lately, the girls in my class
have been improving by leaps and bounds.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to fall behind either...!
I'd like to train a little more today!"
choice_data_list: Got it! Let's keep running until you're satisfied!
Calm down, you're going to overwork yourself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I'll do my best so I can deliver good results!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Special Week and I devoted ourselves
to training until the very last minute.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
R-Right, that's true...
I might've gotten a little too carried away.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I need to cool my head...
Deep breath, deep breath... Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week seems to have calmed down.
Still, I have to match her enthusiasm...
